Apparently working 8–10 hours a day is a vacation now.

CEOs and managers are crashing out over employees having lives, turning off their phones after work, wearing the business casual clothes they were literally told to wear, and generally refusing to make their job their entire personality.

Work 24/7. Almost die for the customer. Dress business casual — but not THAT business casual. And whatever you do, never forget: somehow you’re still not working hard enough.

Are these people okay?

#CorporateAmerica #WorkCulture #JobMarket
